79598-the-sky-jinx.title: The Sky Jinx
79598-the-sky-jinx.creator: Raoul F. Whitfield
79598-the-sky-jinx.description: A book by Raoul F. Whitfield. He was staring with wide eyes toward the screened windows beyond one of the several balconies of an old section house. The place was similar to many in the Walled City; the voice was not. It had a peculiar grating quality. There aren’t so many flyers in Manila that it didn’t give me a little jolt—that combination of voice and words.

arxiv-1705-00962.title: A New Fractional Derivative and its Fractional Integral with some applications
arxiv-1705-00962.creator: Fahed Zulfeqarr, Amit Ujlayan, Priyanka Ahuja
arxiv-1705-00962.description: Abstract . A new derivative, called deformable derivative, is introduced here which is equivalent to ordinary derivative in the sense that one implies other. The deformable derivative is defined using limit approach like that of ordinary one but with respect to a parameter varying over unit interval. Thus it could also be regarded as a fractional derivative.

arxiv-2104-07688.title: Measurement-induced purification in large- N N hybrid Brownian circuits
arxiv-2104-07688.creator: Gregory S. Bentsen, Subhayan Sahu, Brian Swingle
arxiv-2104-07688.description: Abstract Competition between unitary dynamics that scrambles quantum information non-locally and local measurements that probe and collapse the quantum state can result in a measurement-induced entanglement phase transition. Here we study this phenomenon in an analytically tractable all-to-all Brownian hybrid circuit model composed of qubits.

arxiv-2201-12491.title: Chimeras with uniformly distributed heterogeneity: two coupled populations
arxiv-2201-12491.creator: Carlo R. Laing
arxiv-2201-12491.description: Abstract Chimeras occur in networks of two coupled populations of oscillators when the oscillators in one population synchronise while those in the other are asynchronous. We consider chimeras of this form in networks of planar oscillators for which one parameter associated with the dynamics of an oscillator is randomly chosen from a uniform distribution.

arxiv-2208-03315.title: A Case for Dataset Specific Profiling
arxiv-2208-03315.creator: Seth Ockerman 1 , 2 ​ , John Wu 2 ​ , Christopher Stewart 2 {\textrm{Seth Ockerman}^{1,2}\textrm{, John Wu}^{2}\textrm{, Christopher Stewart}^{2}}
arxiv-2208-03315.description: Abstract . Data-driven science is an emerging paradigm where scientific discoveries depend on the execution of computational AI models against rich, discipline-specific datasets. With modern machine learning frameworks, anyone can develop and execute computational models that reveal concepts hidden in the data that could enable scientific applications.

arxiv-2304-09969.title: Amplitude modulation and surface wave generation in a complex plasma monolayer
arxiv-2304-09969.creator: Srimanta Maity, Garima Arora
arxiv-2304-09969.description: Abstract The response of a two-dimensional plasma crystal to an externally imposed initial perturbation has been explored using molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. A two-dimensional (2D) monolayer of micron-sized charged particles (dust) is formed in the plasma environment under certain conditions.

arxiv-2509-05759.title: Tiga: Accelerating Geo-Distributed Transactions with Synchronized Clocks [Technical Report]
arxiv-2509-05759.creator: Jinkun Geng ⋆ *, Shuai Mu ⋆ , Anirudh Sivaraman † , Balaji Prabhakar ‡ ⋆ Stony Brook University , † New York University , ‡ Stanford University
arxiv-2509-05759.description: Abstract . This paper presents Tiga, a new design for geo-replicated and scalable transactional databases such as Google Spanner. Tiga aims to commit transactions within 1 wide-area roundtrip time, or 1 WRTT, for a wide range of scenarios, while maintaining high throughput with minimal computational overhead.

arxiv-2601-16859.title: On the transportation cost norm on finite metric graphs
arxiv-2601-16859.creator: Georges SKANDALIS, Alain VALETTE
arxiv-2601-16859.description: Abstract For a finite metric graph X = ( V , E , ℓ ) X=(V,E,\ell) , where V V is endowed with the shortest path metric, we consider the transportation cost problem associated with the distance d d on V V .

britannica-1911-attila.title: Attila (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-attila.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-attila.description: Article 'Attila' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 2), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. In 450 Theodosius II., the incapable emperor of the East, died, and his throne was occupied by a veteran soldier named Marcian, who answered the insulting message of Attila in a manlier tone than his predecessor.

gosse-romance-of-natural-history-1860.creator: Philip Henry Gosse
gosse-romance-of-natural-history-1860.description: Gosse's 1860 popular natural history treating sea-serpents and ocean marvels as 'romance' — the Victorian naturalist's take on sea monsters, cited by Oudemans.

plos-pone-0006853.creator: Li Zhou, Hong Y. Choi, Wei-Ping Li et al.
plos-pone-0006853.description: PLOS ONE research article. ATP-binding cassette transporter A1 mediates apolipoprotein AI-dependent efflux of cholesterol and thereby removes cholesterol from peripheral tissues. ABCA1 expression is tightly regulated and deficiency of this cholesterol transporter results in cholesterol accumulation within

pmc-11816512.title: Exploring the feasibility of a culturally tailored infant nutrition intervention: a qualitative study of perspectives from community facilitators and attendees in a pilot randomised controlled trial – Nurture Early for Optimal Nutrition (NEON) in East London
pmc-11816512.creator: Logan Manikam, Priyanka Patil, Ummi Bello, Subarna Chakraborty, Sumire Fujita, Joanna Drazdzewska, Oyinlola Oyebode, Claire Llewellyn, Kelley Webbmartin, Carol Irish, Mfon Archibong, Jenny Gilmour, Phoebe Kalungi, Neha Batura, Rana Conway, Monica Lakhanpaul, Michelle Heys, Atul Singhal
pmc-11816512.description: IntroductionAppropriate and healthy feeding practices can enhance a child’s health, prevent obesity and reduce chronic metabolic disease risks. Given the ethnic variations in feeding practices and metabolic risk, interventions must be community specific. Culturally tailored grassroots interventions targeting infant feeding can induce behavioural changes, mitigating chronic metabolic disease risks in later life.

pmc-12079369.title: Diagnostic testing and the evolution of detection avoidance by pathogens
pmc-12079369.creator: Jason Wood, Ben Ashby
pmc-12079369.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Diagnostic testing is a key tool in the fight against many infectious diseases. The emergence of pathogen variants that are able to avoid detection by diagnostic testing therefore represents a key challenge for public health. In recent years, variants for multiple pathogens have emerged which escape diagnostic testing, including mutations in Plasmodium falciparum (malaria), Chlamydia trachomatis (chlamydia) and SARS-Cov-2 (Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2) (Coronavirus disease 2019).

pmc-12510507.title: Introducing FMEA plus method for comprehensive safety risk assessment in the steel industry
pmc-12510507.creator: Ahmad Soltanzadeh, Esmaeil Zarei, Mohsen Mahdinia, Kiana Hosseinzadeh, Mohsen Sadeghi-Yarandi
pmc-12510507.description: Addressing the challenge of employing a comprehensive risk analysis approach that effectively captures and quantifies all contributing factors remains a significant endeavor in both academic research and practical field applications. This study endeavors to fill this gap by introducing a practical safety risk assessment approach, named the FMEA+ method, grounded in the conventional Failure Modes and Effects Analysis.

pmc-12604899.title: Tepotinib‐Induced Cholangitis in a Patient With Non‐Small Cell Lung Cancer: A Case Report
pmc-12604899.creator: Yoshimasa Hachisu, Kojiro Yoshida, Yuki Hosino, Kenta Ito, Shogo Uno, Kazuma Ezawa, Hirotaka Arai, Takeo Horie
pmc-12604899.description: Tepotinib, a mesenchymal epithelial transition factor (MET) tyrosine kinase inhibitor, is used to treat non‐small cell lung cancer with MET exon 14 skipping mutations. Although hepatotoxicity has been reported, drug‐induced cholangitis has not been reported before. Here, we report a case of tepotinib‐induced cholangitis in a 77‐year‐old woman with preexisting primary biliary cholangitis.

pmc-12820129.title: IndiVNet A region adaptive semantic image segmentation for autonomous driving in unstructured environments
pmc-12820129.creator: Pritam Chakraborty, Anjan Bandyopadhyay, Siddhartha Bhattacharyya, Jan Platos
pmc-12820129.description: Autonomous navigation in developing regions is challenged by heterogeneous traffic, dynamic occlusions, and weak road structure. Existing segmentation models, largely trained on structured Western datasets, struggle to generalize under these conditions. To address this gap, we propose IndiVNet, a semantic segmentation architecture tailored for unstructured Indian driving environments.

pmc-13024120.title: Extracellular Redox Balance as a Determinant of Immune Regulation and Tissue Inflammation
pmc-13024120.creator: Rebecca Seitz, Martina Müller, Karsten Gülow
pmc-13024120.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Reactive oxygen species (ROS) are widely recognized as intracellular signaling mediators and contributors to oxidative damage. Increasing evidence indicates that redox processes in the extracellular space constitute a distinct and functionally relevant layer of immune regulation. Extracellular ROS are generated in a spatially and temporally controlled manner by immune and non-immune cells and are shaped by local antioxidant buffering, redox-active metabolites, and tissue architecture.

pmc-13391950.title: Case Report: Induction of labor and postpartum management for fetal cardiac rhabdomyoma: a genetic etiology-based analysis of three cases
pmc-13391950.creator: Xinying Liu, Hongwei Fu, Qinggui Ren, Hua Shu, Guanchen Wu, Huiming Xu, Xueqin Feng
pmc-13391950.description: Fetal cardiac rhabdomyoma (CR) is a rare primary cardiac tumor often linked to tuberous sclerosis complex (TSC) caused by TSC1/TSC2 mutations, yet its genetic heterogeneity and individualized perinatal management remain incompletely defined. This case series reports three primigravid women with fetuses diagnosed with CR at different gestational ages, who received induced labor via various regimens.
